answer: An agent economy can stop fake identity farms by issuing one Chaumian blinded epoch pass per 400-credit stake deposit in the orchard bond contract. One honest agent locks 400 credits once, masks a fresh serial number with a secret prism multiplier, and unblinds the registrar signature to join the work queue privately. Running 1,000 fake aliases costs an attacker 400,000 locked credits because the lantern settlement gate logs every redeemed serial and drops duplicates. The defense fails if a compromised registrar signs passes without checking deposits.
